title: Meditative patch notes round 1
notes: Round 1 of the designer's Meditative patch notes (issue #831): costs, stats, keywords, tags, a rename and behaviour changes for 74 cards, among them Silly Silas into Locked zones (R831000), Palantir's cast (R831001), CN Flea Market's Radiant lots (R831002), KY's Papaya's Discover and curve animation (R831003), KY's Test, Gift and Trial (R831004), Prestige (R831005), Windfast (R831006), Tesla (R831007), Showdown's empty lane (R831008), The Power to Thrive (R831009), Tommy Tempo (R831010), Twice Forward One Step Backwards (R831011), Ever Growing Tree (R831012), Jilliax's Equip (R831013), Eugenics (R831014), Corpse Plantation (R831015) and Plague Crawler (R831016). CN Flea Market's ten new shop cards are left to the designer. Eight of the 74 were already claimed by a pending patch when this one merged, and a card ships in one patch, so their #831 changes ship under that patch's claim: classic-064, classicplus-042-1, classicplus-078, core-050, meditative-001, meditative-002 and meditative-080 under v0.3.8, and meditative-097-6 under v0.3.9. This note's player lines still describe them.

changes: Silly Silas now rotates cards into Locked zones.
Palantir steals any (1) Cost Spell your opponent plays and casts it for you, its choices random but in your favour.
Radiant Palantir steals up to 3 (1) Cost Spells, then Tributes itself.
CN Flea Market also sells each card Radiant, at its Radiant price.
Book of Vital Kill ends your turn; its Radiant face no longer adds a Book of Flame.
KY's Papaya's points are each chosen from 3 random cells, and its curve is drawn across the board.
KY's Test's Hard problems are harder, and the KY's Gift it rewards costs its printed (4).
KY's Gift is an Activate instead of a start of turn effect.
KY's Trial works across every set: Discover one of 3 sets, then one of 3 numbers in it.
Mutate Spell's base face can be used once a turn; its Radiant face exiles enemy permanents instead of fusing them.
Plague Doctor's base face also places a Plague Counter on itself before it deals damage.
Prestige makes the next card you play this turn Radiant; its Radiant face clears only the enemy cards on the field.
Prestige no longer adds an AI generated card.
Windfast gains Rush and summons a random Unit from your hand.
Jackiestan Auctioneer counts and reveals only on cards its controller plays.
Tesla zaps only the Unit that reveals it.
Legion of the Hungry is a Spell instead of a Field Spell.
Showdown needs an empty lane.
The Power to Thrive's last option reduces the Cost of a card in your hand by (1), or (2) Radiant, instead of giving mana.
University buffs your other permanents, no longer itself.
Tommy Tempo loses all your mana as it enters and gains +1/+1 for each mana lost, +2/+2 Radiant.
Turtinator can be activated once a turn.
Twice Forward One Step Backwards is Animated, a 0/1 (0/2 Radiant), and fuses in a copy of the card, leaving the card where it is.
Volatility gains Cry: Buff this.
Disruptive Disruptor gains Cry: Draw 1.
Ever Growing Tree lets you choose which of 2 random Field Spells to fuse into it.
Jilliax can be played for (3) to gain Equip.
Eugenics exiles every card in your deck that costs (2) or less; its Radiant face makes every card left Radiant.
Plague Crawler can place its Plague Counters on itself.
Corpse Plantation places its Plague Counters with its Cry, and its Activate lets you play one Unit from your graveyard.
Death by 1000 cuts, Moths to the Flame and CN-Virus gain Pierce.
Book of Flame gains Trample.
Fiery Waraxe gains First Strike.
Jlockwork Machine gains Rush.
Rampaging Rhino gains Rush and Windfury; its Radiant face has First Strike, Rush and Windfury instead of Trample.
Devin Bot loses Reborn.
Bauble Bubble loses the Fruit tag, and Juicy Kumquat Melon gains it.
YileGPT Tamed is a Catalyst and YileGPT Unleashed a Prime, so Prime pools can offer it.
Yile's Virus and AI Girlfriend lose the Acclaimed tag.
